title: Lewis D NDE 266
content: I was transported on a life-flight chopper, and they put the wires onto my heart to watch my vital signs. Then they said, 'We are losing him,' and then stuck me with a long needle in my chest. At that time, everything went black, so black it was as though I could feel it. Then I saw a ball of light that seemed to be moving closer to me, it seemed to rouse interest in me at the time. I was moving closer to the ball it was perfectly round with twinkles in it. Then a big hand and arm, very strong looking, came into view coming to grasp this ball of light all the time saying with a low voice saying, 'I have everything under control.' It was as if I was a part of this light somehow. I felt afraid no more as soon as I saw the light and the voice.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Depressed commuted skull fracture with multiple hematomas And profuse bleeding, and shock. I fell and had my head smashed, resulting in a much loss of blood, and brain damage.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I felt I was a part of this ball of light that was drawing me. I was the twinkles in it.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was aware of nothing going on in the life-flight chopper after they said we are losing him, and it went black.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I know I lived my life's events all over in a moment of time.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: All sound of the engine of the chopper in flight stopped, it became very quiet. But the sound of the voice, a calm voice, reassuring me that everything will be taken care of.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain I was nearing a great ball of light that seemed to draw me gently to it.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes A ball that looked round like a moon but only very white with twinkles in it.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I feel it is near but not reachable by me.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: All fear was gone, and a restfulness was all around me.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe That everything is simpler than I ever thought before.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control Past events that I had forgot passed so fast that I could not believe the speed. Things I thought I had forgot about, like faults.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I am not afraid of death anymore.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I am not afraid of death anymore. After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: That I saw this ball of light but could not stay longer to learn more.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes They felt calmed by what I said.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: It was real, and not a dream.
